items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Ralph Cooper brought me in there, see.

ctx.x: We were talking about the Apollo Theatre, see, I went there from the Lafayette into the Opera House in '30 and went into the Apollo Theatre, I think it's in '31. Now, all the big bands came in there and that was an era of productivity, oh, they were beautiful see, all new bands would come along and we had -- I remember Ralph Cooper was MC'ing, Willie Bryant was MC, another guy was there, he played golf.
